newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Nov 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Nov 25.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page:
SARAJEVO, BOSNIA - A Serb-controlled court annulled the first opposition victory in Belgrade since 1945.
MANILA - President Clinton has put U.S. ties with Asia back on track with a series of high-level talks at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum.
MURRAY HILL, NEW JERSEY - Competition in the telecommunications market has changed the way scientists work.
PARIS - Survivors of a hijacked Ethiopian jetliner that crashed into the Indian Ocean told how their drunken hijackers fought with the pilot and did not believe that the plane would run out of fuel.
BEIJING - President Clinton has shifted the emphasis of his human rights policy to constructing a stable political relationship with China, Asia's emerging superpower.

WASHINGTON - In the midst of a national debate over education, elementary schools in Calvert County have successfully implemented school reform, adopting a new curriculum that espouses old fashioned learning.
